Crime & Law · India

Three Tamil men shot dead in Karnataka; probe demanded

Three Tamil men were shot dead by Karnataka Forest Department personnel in the Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has called the explanation provided by the Karnataka Forest Department "unacceptable" and demanded a high-level probe into the incident. Some reports identify the deceased as "poachers". Protests have occurred, and forest officials have been booked for murder. The Karnataka government stated it would not target any organization.
